verso-plugin-ddns.description: Session grants for Verso's Dynamic DNS page: ddns-scripts' own config; the network config, for the interfaces an update can follow; and the helper's read of what each updater last did. The shell holds the operator's session and performs these on the plugin's behalf (ADR-007), so this file is what makes the manifest's declared acl grantable at rpcd — the plugin itself holds no session and no privilege.
